faqs.answer_en: Gurmad Educational Hub is based in Garowe, Puntland, Somalia. It is founded and directed by Eng. Yasin Mohamed Hassan, and offers practical education and training, including AI training and student support.
faqs.answer_so: Gurmad Educational Hub waxay ku taallaa Garowe, Puntland, Somalia. Waxaa aasaasay oo maamula Eng. Yasin Mohamed Hassan, waxayna bixisaa waxbarasho iyo tababar la taaban karo, oo ay ku jiraan tababarka AI iyo taageerada ardayda.

faqs.answer_en: The Hub offers practical AI and ChatGPT training, education and training services, and student support, including help for Somali students pursuing further study and university applications. For current courses, prices and start dates, please contact the team — prices are confirmed before quoting, never guessed.
faqs.answer_so: Hub-ku wuxuu bixiyaa tababar AI iyo ChatGPT oo la taaban karo, adeegyo waxbarasho iyo tababar, iyo taageero arday, oo ay ku jirto caawinta ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee raadinaya waxbarasho sare iyo codsiyada jaamacadaha. Qiimaha iyo taariikhda bilowga, fadlan la xiriir kooxda.

faqs.answer_en: Prices depend on the course or service and are confirmed by the team before quoting. Please send your name and what you need, and the team will reply with the current price.
faqs.answer_so: Qiimuhu wuxuu ku xiran yahay koorsada ama adeegga, kooxda ayaa xaqiijisa ka hor inta aan la sheegin. Fadlan soo dir magacaaga iyo waxaad u baahan tahay, kooxda ayaa kuu soo diri doonta qiimaha hadda.

faqs.answer_en: You can reach the Hub through this Facebook Page, or at gurmad@gurmadtechnology.online. Or type 'human' here and the team will reply on Messenger.
faqs.answer_so: Waxaad la xiriiri kartaa Hub-ka boggan Facebook, ama gurmad@gurmadtechnology.online. Ama qor 'human' halkan, kooxda ayaa Messenger kugu soo jawaabi doonta.

menu.answer_en: The Hub offers practical AI and ChatGPT training, plus education and training services for individuals, students, and businesses in Garowe. Its flagship training is AI Mastery: Tools, Agents & Intelligent Systems, an intensive 8-week program, 8-10 hours per week, from beginner level to building practical AI workflows, connected applications, and simple AI agents, with a 70% graduation requirement including a functional capstone. For current prices and start dates, please contact the team.
menu.answer_so: Hub-ku wuxuu bixiyaa tababar AI iyo ChatGPT oo la taaban karo, iyo adeegyo waxbarasho iyo tababar loogu talagalay shakhsiyaadka, ardayda, iyo ganacsiyada Garowe. Tababarkiisa ugu muhiimsan waa AI Mastery, barnaamij 8 toddobaad ah, 8-10 saacadood toddobaadkii, laga bilaabo heerka bilowga ilaa dhisidda AI workflows, applications iyo agents fudud, oo qalin-jabintu u baahan tahay 70%. Qiimaha iyo taariikhda bilowga, fadlan la xiriir kooxda.
menu.label: Courses and training

menu.answer_en: The Hub supports students, including help for Somali students pursuing further study and university applications. Tell us the student's goal, current level, and what help is needed, and the team will reply with the next step.
menu.answer_so: Hub-ku wuxuu taageeraa ardayda, oo ay ku jirto caawinta ardayda Soomaaliyeed ee raadinaya waxbarasho sare iyo codsiyada jaamacadaha. Noo sheeg hadafka ardayga, heerkiisa hadda, iyo caawinta loo baahan yahay, kooxda ayaa kuu soo diri doonta tallaabada xigta.
menu.label: Student support

menu.answer_en: The Hub also works with schools and small businesses on practical AI training and digital skills. Tell us your organisation type and the problem you want to solve, and the team will suggest a practical first step.
menu.answer_so: Hub-ku wuxuu sidoo kale la shaqeeyaa dugsiyada iyo ganacsiyada yaryar tababarka AI iyo xirfadaha digital-ka. Noo sheeg nooca hay'addaada iyo dhibaatada aad rabto inaad xalliso, kooxda ayaa kuu soo jeedin doonta tallaabo hore oo la taaban karo.
